note: Actual customs evidence is import-side only, and it is strong: e.g. "2026-02-02 SHIJIAZUANG JIFENG DIAMOND TOOLS CO.,LTD. DAYANAND POWER TOOLS 113X11X1.8X20MM MARBLE BLADE ... Ningbo, CHINA -> AHEMDABAD ICD INSBI6, India 82023900 7245800" and "2026-01-12 ZHENJIANG LANCHER TOOLS CO.,LTD ... DIAMOND SAW BLADE 250X20MM CUP TURBO ... MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India 82023900 6837614". So the firm is a real, active importer/distributor of power-tool and diamond-blade goods from China (latest record 2026-02-02), i.e. role is trader/importer rather than exporter. Declared HS 820411 (hand-operated spanners/wrenches) does not match the observed trade codes 82023900 (circular saw blades), 84679900 (parts of hand tools), 85365090, 49070030 — per project rules this is NOT a rejection ground; the factual code should be corrected to 82023900 / 84679900 and the verdict kept as accepted with HS correction. No export shipments and no domestic supply evidence (GST/tenders) were found in accessible sources; revenue and export volume: null (not public). Note also that the ImportKey 'Buyers' aggregate mixes several unrelated companies, so it must not be read as proof of this firm's exports.
